title: Tool Host and Gateway workload identity

cases.title: A device certificate cannot act as a Tool Host
cases.when: An enrolled device certificate calls tool-hosts/registrations and permits/consume for a Tool Host permit
then: 403 for both: the device CA is not the workload CA pin

cases.title: Registration and every Tool Host call are bound to the certificate SAN
cases.when: A Tool Host certificate for host-1 registers as host-2, and later calls the heartbeat for an invocation leased to host-2

cases.title: A disabled host is refused at its next Control call
cases.when: An admin disables host-1 while it runs an invocation
then: The next heartbeat, secret delivery and consumption are refused
The running invocation ends per lease rules

cases.title: A host identity never acts for another tenant
cases.when: A certificate whose SAN names tenant A consumes a permit for tenant B

cases.title: The Tool Host accepts dispatch only from Gateway identities
cases.when: A Tool Host certificate and a device certificate each open the dispatch stream
then: Both are refused at TLS or first frame
